chunks: Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام: A man forces himself upon a woman. He said: “He is to be killed.”

key_terms.يَغْصِبُ الْمَرْأَةَ نَفْسَهَا: to force himself upon a woman against her will
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: he is to be killed; a ruling of capital punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a man who forcibly violates a woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام concerning a man who sexually assaults a woman by force. The ruling given is capital punishment, indicating the grave seriousness of this act in Shia legal tradition.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5374 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Zurara, who said:

I asked Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about a man who forces himself upon a woman.
Imam (as) said: "He is to be killed."
